findings: Stocks' equation: textbook 90% intervals covered 88% of months since 2000 (84% since 2022); adaptive conformal intervals covered 90% (84% since 2022). Honest intervals today are 1.04 times the textbook width.
Since 2022 the stacked ensemble puts 61% on the no-link model: same-month moves in oil, prices and the 10-year have not improved out-of-sample forecasts of stocks.

An unseen cause would need to explain 22% of the residual variance of both the 10-year yield and stocks to erase the 2022-on link (it is already not significant at 5%); the strongest observed parent, cpi, explains 4%.

method: Recursive regression on standardized monthly changes, ordered oil, CPI, 10-year, stocks, VIX, gold
